name: Invocation of the Founders
description: A magical rite in the Biblioplex that repels the Phyrexian attackers when each school contributes.

description_citations.text: "Zimone Wola". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Invocation of the Founders is used during the Invasion, creating a fractal tree that breaks through the building's ceiling.
timeline.quote: the spell was housed deep within the library, until it was used during the New Phyrexian Invasion , when a massive fractal tree was created in the chamber's center, breaking through the building's ceiling.

citation.text: "Biblioplex", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes Quintorius has ignited as a planeswalker during the Invocation.
timeline.quote: Liliana quickly deduced that he had actually ignited as a Planeswalker.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Against the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The compleated Nassari distracts Rootha, so Quint compensates with raw magic and lifeforce; his spark ignites and he planeswalks away, though the Invocation repels the main wave.
timeline.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Dina", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Invocation of the Founders temporarily thwarts the invasion of Arcavios.
timeline.quote: The Invocation of the Founders temporarily thwarted the invasion

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Invasion, Quint tries to cover for Rootha at the Invocation of the Founders with raw magic, his spark ignites, and he planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Quintorius", section "New Phyrexian Invasion of Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Vess sends surviving students to activate the Invocation of the Founders; Quint's spark ignites and he planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: in the process, Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away

citation.text: "Zimone Wola", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The spell obliterates the main Phyrexian wave and restores Nassari's elemental body.
timeline.quote: the main wave of compleated professors and other Phyrexians was obliterated by the spell

citation.text: "Invocation of the Founders", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
